title: ActorAgentManageRequest
description: actor.agent-manage-request@1: bodies of actor.agent.manage on OpenVibe.Actor. POST /api/v1/me/agents { name, instructions, mode?, budget_per_run_usd?, daily_runs_max?, schedule?, schedule_at?, schedule_dow?, status? } creates a personal agent (10 per person: 429 actor.agent.limit); PATCH /api/v1/me/agents/:id takes any subset. POST /api/v1/me/agents/:id/memory { text } adds a note (1–1000 characters; 50 notes, the oldest agent-written note goes first, a person's note never automatically) and PATCH /api/v1/me/agents/:id/memory/:mem { text } edits one. Unknown fields are 422 actor.agent.invalid; another person's agent is 404 actor.agent.not_found.

budget_per_run_usd.description: At most the person's per-task allowance.

schedule_at.description: HH:MM UTC, for daily and weekly.
